questions.question_text: Analyze how Donald J. Sobol builds suspense and demonstrates lateral thinking in 'The Case of the Fifth Word'.
questions.correct_answer: Sobol sets up a classic puzzle where police authority is stumped by four seemingly random words. By showing Chief and Mrs. Brown pursuing dead-end linguistic theories, Sobol creates suspense. The climax resolves when Encyclopedia shifts focus from literal definitions to the physical origin of the paper—a torn calendar sheet. This demonstrates lateral thinking: solving problems by changing perspective rather than forcing standard logic.
